description:
**MID TERRACED HOUSE ARRANGED AS TWO TENANTED FLATS, IN A GREAT AREA WITH NO ONWARD CHAIN** Tenanted Mid Terraced House arranged as Two Flats; Ground Floor Flat comprising; Lounge, Kitchen, Bedroom, Bathroom, Enclosed Rear Garden. First Floor Flat comprises Landing, Lounge, Kitchen, Bedroom, Bathroom, No Onward Chain Involved, Both Flats are Tenanted with an 11% ROI & are Council Tax Band A

Entrance Hallway - Communal Entrance for both flats

Flat 1 - 

Bedroom 1 - 3.48m x 4.75m (11'5 x 15'7) - Double glazed walk in bay window to front, radiator

Lounge - 3.71m x 4.06m (12'2 x 13'4) - Double glazed window to rear, radiator

Kitchen - 3.05m x 4.45m (10'0 x 14'7) - Fitted base & wall units with round edge worktops, stainless steel sink with mixer taps, electric oven, gas hob with extractor hood over, plumbing for washing machine, vent for dryer, double glazed window to rear, concealed wall mounted gas combination boiler, double glazed door to side

Shower Room - 0.84m x 3.02m (2'9 x 9'11) - Fitted with a 3 piece suite comprising low level wc, shower enclosure, pedestal wash hand basin

Outside - Enclosed rear garden, paved patio, gated access to rear

Flat 2 - 

Landing - Stairs to First Floor Landing, velux to rear

Lounge - 4.67m x 3.71m (15'4 x 12'2) - Teo double glazed windows to front, radiator, electric fire

Kitchen - 2.54m x 3.05m (8'4 x 10'0) - Fitted base & wall units with round edge worktops, stainless steel sink with mixer taps & tiled splashbacks, gas cooker, plumbing for washing machine, double glazed window to rear, concealed wall mounted gas combination boiler

Bedroom - 2.97m x 4.06m (9'9 x 13'4) - Double glazed window to rear, radiator

Bathroom - 2.06m x 1.78m (6'9 x 5'10) - Fitted with a 3 piece suite comprising low level wc, panelled bath with glass screen & shower over, pedestal wash hand basin, double glazed window to rear
